changeSet.author: abhijith

preConditions.onFailMessage: project_spatial_node holds duplicate root (project_id, code) rows; find them with: SELECT project_id, code, count(*) FROM project_spatial_node WHERE parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY project_id, code HAVING count(*) > 1; merge or recode the extra buildings, then rerun the migration
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT project_id, code FROM project_spatial_node WHERE parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY project_id, code HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicates

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_spatial_node_root_code ON project_spatial_node (project_id, code) WHERE parent_id IS NULL
